task_text: I woke up late and have to leave for work in 10 minutes. I need something quick to eat, and the living room should be tidy so I can grab my things and go.

plans.R1:
Based on the images and the task requirements, here's a plan for preparing a quick meal and ensuring the living room is tidy:

### [0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice bread using the knife. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place sliced bread on a plate. (r1_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the apple from the fridge. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the apple. (r1_s4)

### [5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place sliced apple on the plate with bread. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pour coffee into the cup. (r1_s6)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the plate and cup to another robot for delivery to the living room. (r1_s7)

This plan ensures a quick meal is prepared and ready to be taken to the living room.

[5-10 min]

plans.R3:
Based on the images of the living room, here's a plan to help you get ready quickly:

[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the laptop from the couch and place it on the coffee table. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the paper from the couch and place it on the coffee table. (r3_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the remote control from the coffee table and place it neatly next to the vase. (r3_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the fruit from the coffee table and slice it for a quick snack. (r3_s4)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pour a glass of water from the water dispenser. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Place the sliced fruit and water on the coffee table for you to grab and eat quickly. (r3_s6)

This plan ensures the living room is tidy and you have a quick snack ready before leaving for work.
